docs_search.description: Keyword search and retrieval over the repository's Markdown documentation folder (docs/). Tools: search_docs ranks pages by title, heading, and body matches with line-numbered snippets; read_doc returns a page or line range; list_docs lists pages by section. Read-only and confined to the docs folder. Set ATLAS_DOCS_ROOT in env to point at a different docs folder.
docs_search.author: Chat UI Team
